item.text:
I can’t reliably certify a maximum-points schedule for this many offices and travel-time constraints by hand. I don’t want to present a plausible schedule as optimal when it may leave points on the table.

A small scheduling solver would need to choose each office’s 30-minute start and team, while enforcing availability, team overlap, walking time, and daily lunch breaks, then maximize the tier score. If you can run a solver or provide a candidate schedule, I can help check its feasibility and score.
